description: This file defines the ContextHandler class in the Drupal core plugin context namespace, implementing context management methods such as filtering plugin definitions by contexts, checking requirements, and applying context mappings.

classes.name: ContextHandler
classes.description: Provides methods to handle sets of contexts within Drupal's plugin system, including filtering, requirement checking, and context application.

methods.name: filterPluginDefinitionsByContexts
methods.description: Filters plugin definitions based on provided contexts, utilizing cached requirement checks for efficiency.

methods.name: getContextDefinitions
methods.description: Retrieves context definitions from a plugin definition, supporting both interface and array formats.

methods.name: checkRequirements
methods.description: Checks if the given contexts satisfy the specified requirements.

methods.name: getMatchingContexts
methods.description: Filters contexts to find those that satisfy a given context definition.

methods.name: applyContextMapping
methods.description: Applies context mappings to a plugin, handling missing and required contexts, and throwing exceptions if necessary.
